description: Use it when the person describes the yachts they want: where, when, how many people, a size, a type or a budget. Pass each wish as its typed filter (a list is any of its values; every filter must hold), and from / to whenever they gave exact days. With dates every row is free for that stay and carries its price, list price, discount and when the source was checked (checkedAt); without dates each row has its from-price. priceMin / priceMax count the mandatory extras. notApplied lists the wishes that could not narrow the search. When nothing matches exactly, the rows are the nearest match and nearest says what was widened: tell the person. Paged: total and cursor. For deals or last-minute offers call best_deals; for what a stay costs before any dates, price_range; once they name or pick one, get_yacht. When the person likes a yacht, offer a written quote from our desk: ask for their email or phone, then call request_quote with that yacht's link, their dates and party. Send them to the website only if they decline to give a contact. When the person picks a yacht, call request_quote (ask their email or phone first).

discountOnly.description: true: only those with a discount the source states.

limit.description: Rows per page: 50 when not given; at most 50 when browsing, 20 once the person is signed in.

nearKm.description: The distance from the map point, km.

nearLat.description: A map point's latitude, with nearLon and nearKm: those based within nearKm of it, nearest first.

nights.description: Instead of to: how many nights from from. Leave both out for each item's lowest stated stay, with its nights.

page.description: With place, placeId or nearLat: the page, from 1.

pageSize.description: With place, placeId or nearLat: rows per page.

place.description: Where, in words: a region, country, area, town or base, as BM names it. A name two places share answers both under ambiguous: ask which, then pass its id as placeId.

placeId.description: A place id from list_places, or from an ambiguous answer.

priceMax.description: The most to pay, in the site currency: the price plus the mandatory extras.

priceMin.description: The least to pay, in the site currency: the price plus the mandatory extras.

product.description: How it is sold, as the inventory source names it.

text.description: Words in its name or model, e.g. a builder or a model name.
